raw.details:
Procon Jr. is a premier school-level competitive programming contest, inspired by the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI). The event identifies and celebrates budding coding talent among school students through challenging algorithmic and problem-solving tasks that test logical reasoning, creativity, and coding expertise.

The competition also provides unique academic benefits: winners will receive Bonus Points for IIIT-Delhi admissions via JAC counselling, with each point equivalent to a 1 percentile increase in JEE Main score.

Guidelines:

  • Eligibility: Open to all registered school students (up to Class 12).
  • Participation is individual only – team participation is not allowed.
  • Inter-specialization team members: Not applicable (since this event is for school students).

Format:

  • Final Round (On-site at IIIT-Delhi campus): Top 40–50 qualifiers, 3 hours duration.
  • Number of Problems: 4-7 IOI-style algorithmic problems (exact number revealed during the contest).
  • Platform: Online round conducted on a coding contest platform with auto-judging; final round held at IIIT-Delhi.

Additional Benefits: Bonus points in IIIT-Delhi admissions (via JAC) for top 3 participants.

Rules:

  • You can come to contest even if you have missed the registration just join the group
  • Each participant must be a currently enrolled school student (up to Class 12).
  • Participation is strictly individual – no teams allowed.
  • Submissions must be made only on the contest platform. External IDEs may be used locally, but the final code must be submitted online.
  • Code plagiarism or unfair means will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Problems will follow an IOI-style format with partial marking based on test case passes.
  • Decisions of the organizing committee will be final and binding in all matters.
  • For the final on-campus round, participants must carry a valid school ID card for verification.
  • Any technical or system-related issues during the online round must be reported immediately to organizers, but extra time will not be granted.
